title: No runbook for narrow live wire-shape probes of Anthropic-compatible providers (GLM/DeepSeek)
wanted_capability: A documented procedure for safely curl-probing the Anthropic-compatible provider endpoints (GLM z.ai, DeepSeek) to validate bro-harness transport wire shapes — where credentials live, how to capture/parse the SSE stream, and token hygiene — so an agent validating Anthropic-transport changes doesn't rediscover the mechanics each time.
missing_primitive: A runbook (or small helper) covering: creds at ~/.claude-{zai,ds}/settings.json under env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (per brofile.rs default_claude_compatible_env); base URLs api.z.ai/api/anthropic and api.deepseek.com/anthropic; POST /v1/messages?beta=true with the anthropic-beta header; incremental SSE parse; and reading the token into a shell var without echoing it.
fallback_used: Read brofile.rs to find credential locations + base URLs; hand-rolled curl + jq + python SSE parsing; sourced tokens into shell vars without printing them.
resolution_note: Shipped sm-live-provider-wire-probe (system-defaults/memories/live-provider-wire-probe.md, catalog-mapped) on feat/minimax-cache-mechanics → beta/blackbox-v2. Covers credential locations (~/.claude-{zai,ds,mm}/settings.json env block for GLM/DeepSeek/MiniMax; MISTRAL_API_KEY env or ~/.vibe/.env for vibebh), Anthropic-shape and chat-completions probe bodies mirroring the harness build_body, cache-validation recipe (512+-token stable prefix, send-twice, read cache_read_input_tokens / prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens), SSE capture guidance, token hygiene (read keys at runtime, redact on print, max_tokens<=16), and report shape (date the evidence — endpoint conclusions decay, per the gap-d64d7a58 cautionary tale). Scope broadened beyond GLM/DeepSeek to MiniMax + Mistral since those probes were performed and verified live 2026-06-11.
